description: All data in transit must be encrypted with TLS 1.2 or higher
remediation_hint: Confirm your FHIR server and app enforce TLS 1.2+ on all endpoints. Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1.

description: Application must implement audit logging for all PHI access events
remediation_hint: Enable comprehensive audit logging covering authentication events, PHI reads, and data exports. Retain logs per HIPAA minimum (6 years).

description: A Business Associate Agreement (BAA) must be in place with Epic and any PHI-handling subprocessors
remediation_hint: Execute a BAA with Epic before accessing production data. Review all third-party services that handle PHI and ensure BAAs exist.
